subject: Pilot capacity jitter buffer and autoscale exemption proposal
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot capacity jitter buffer and autoscale exemption proposal

Hi team,

Following up from last week's product sync: VeloxAI's pilot (VEL-3247) goes live the week of Feb 2 and they have a bursty inference profile that will create intermittent "jitter" on our Dedicated GPU pool if we treat it as a standard reservation. They agreed to a 6-week pilot but need a reliability SLA for sustained low tail latency during demo windows.

Ask: Can we approve a temporary autoscale exemption + small dedicated jitter buffer for this pilot? Summary of the request:
- Window: 2026-02-02 00:00 → 2026-03-16 23:59 (6 weeks)
- Peak concurrent slots: 14 high-priority GPU slots (pinned during demo windows)
- Baseline reservation: 4 slots (reserved capacity) + 10 jitter buffer on top for short bursts
- Fallback: auto-failover to a quantized model variant (VeloxAI accepts modest quality delta for <10% of requests)

Why this is special: VeloxAI's traffic is very bursty (they run scheduled batch fins during business hours + live demos) and the pilot is strongly tied to their procurement decision for Dedicated next quarter. We have two tradeoffs here: (1) temporary cost uplift vs (2) potential for a customer-visible latency regression if we do nothing.

I attached a short runbook (pilot-runbook.pdf) and a slot estimate CSV (slot-estimate.csv) with the request broken down by week. Quick questions for ops/infra:
- Kimberly, can Product accept the conditional SLA (demo windows only) and sign off on the rollback criteria?
- Jonas / Dev, is an autoscale exemption for this window technically possible without risking other enterprise carveouts (i.e., can we enforce preemption policies and timebound gating)?

If we can greenlight this, I'd like to send VeloxAI a one-page MOU and a DocuSign link to lock the demo windows. They asked for confirmation by EOW (Friday).

Thanks —
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Product Manager, Dedicated
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
(attachment: pilot-runbook.pdf, slot-estimate.csv)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot capacity jitter buffer and autoscale exemption proposal

Neha —

Thanks for the clear ask and the runbook. High level: Product is open to a conditional SLA for demo windows, but we need explicit rollback triggers and telemetry to prove the pilot isn't harming other tenants. A few clarifying points before I can sign off:

1) Demo windows definition: please confirm timezone-normalized scheduled slots (e.g., PST 09:00-11:00, 14:00-15:00) and what "short burst" means (<= 10 minutes? 30 minutes?).
2) Cost guardrail: what's the projected incremental spend (weekly) for the jitter buffer? Put that in the slot-estimate.csv but call out worst-case and expected-case.
3) Rollback triggers: suggest (a) 5xx rate >0.5% sustained for 10m on other customers in same pool, or (b) tail latency P95 increase >30% for >15m. Are those acceptable?
4) Can we gate access to the 10 jitter slots so they only apply to VeloxAI's requests (no cross-tenant leakage)?

Jonas / Dev — can you confirm preemption semantics and whether we can implement a short TTL on the jitter buffer so slots free after 30 minutes of inactivity?

Once we have those, Product will sign the MOU for demo windows only.

Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
(attachment referenced: pilot-runbook.pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot capacity jitter buffer and autoscale exemption proposal

Thanks — quick infra notes and constraints. TL;DR: technically feasible with conditions; ops will require a short TTL + strict tenant isolation.

Details:
- Isolation: we can tag the jitter buffer slots to VeloxAI's tenant id and ensure preemptible behavior for other tenants. No cross-tenant leakage.
- TTL: we can enforce a 30-minute inactivity TTL and automatic eviction. That handles the long-tail idle risk.
- Preemption: if global pool pressure reaches 85% for >5m, the jitter buffer slots will be preemptible and we will start draining the oldest jitter allocations first. We'll publish a short BGP-style notice to oncall if preemption is triggered.
- Telemetry hooks: we'll add two dashboards (P95 latency by tenant; 5xx rate by pool) and an automated alert (INF-4210) to Product and Oncall. Linking the Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4210.
- Cost projection: I ran the slot-estimate.csv baseline and worst-case; expected incremental spend is ~$11k/week (expected), worst-case ~$28k/week. Dev, see attached CSV breakdown and confirm numbers.

Ops ask / conditions for approval:
1) Product must accept the rollback triggers Kimberly suggested (5xx >0.5% sustained 10m OR P95 >30% for 15m).
2) VeloxAI must sign an MOU acknowledging we may preempt jitter buffer during global high pressure; they also must accept the quantized fallback for <10% of calls.
3) We need a point-of-contact from VeloxAI for emergency notifications (Slack + email).

If Product confirms, Infra will create the ephemeral policy and schedule the autoscale-exemption window. We can mobilize on Jan 26 to prepare test traffic and smoke the runbook.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
(attachment: slot-estimate.csv)

From: Sienna Carter <sienna@velox.ai>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@velox.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot capacity jitter buffer and autoscale exemption proposal

Neha / team —

Thanks for the fast follow. VeloxAI is comfortable with the proposed rollback triggers and the quantized fallback for a small percentage of calls. We can confirm:
- Demo windows (PST): Tue/Thu 09:00-11:00 and Wed 14:00-15:00 during the pilot window.
- Point of contact: Sienna Carter (sienna@velox.ai); Slack: #velox-pilot (we can add your oncall).
- Procurement: we'll sign the one-page MOU and route the DocuSign link to our procurement team. Please send the link and the finalized MOU text.

We appreciate the TTL and isolation guarantees. Once we get the DocuSign, we'll countersign and confirm the first smoke test date.

Sienna Carter
Head of Platform, VeloxAI
sienna@velox.ai
(attachment: none)
